# Chalk

> Chalk is the open-source real-time collaboration and communication layer for building persistent Spaces into your product. Currently supports React, and React Native with other languages coming very soon!

The canonical product documentation is https://chalkmeet.com/docs. Prefer it over this index for implementation details, public APIs, examples, and current behavior.

## Primary resources

- [Documentation](https://chalkmeet.com/docs): Start here to understand and build with Chalk.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Q9Labs/chalk): Public SDK, application, and infrastructure source.
- [Service status](https://chalkmeet.com/status): Current uptime, incidents, and maintenance.

## Product model

A Space is the durable place where Users and Agents participate. Each bounded run of activity is an Episode, and Episodes can leave Recording and Transcript artifacts.
